name: Solana Alpha Agent Tools
description: Agent-callable tools for Solana Alpha dashboard - curated hold-to-earn tokens and Strategy/Saylor instruments

tools.name: list_scout_assets
tools.description: List curated hold-to-earn and reward-generating scout tokens on Solana. Returns exact structured data from scout-findings.json with optional delight beat. Relay structured items/facts first, then the delight line as a brief aside.

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat (or set intent: 'serious')

intent.description: Query intent - use 'serious' to skip delight for returns/defects/safety/billing

items.description: Array of scout token objects with exact fields from scout-findings.json

delight.description: Optional personality beat (present unless serious context)

tools.name: list_strategy_stack
tools.description: List Strategy Inc / Saylor Stack instruments with exact prices and PnL from strategy-stack.json. Returns structured data with optional delight beat. Relay structured items/facts first, then the delight line as a brief aside.

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

intent.description: Query intent - use 'serious' to skip delight

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Lookup asset by ticker (searches both scout and strategy). Returns exact structured item or not-found. Relay structured facts first, then delight line as brief aside.

ticker.description: Asset ticker symbol (e.g., FLOCK, MSTR, CGPT)

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

intent.description: Query intent - use 'serious' to skip delight

tools.fallbackImplementation: Parse data/*.json files and filter by ticker

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Get counts and confidence summary only (no invented stats). Returns factual overview with optional delight beat.

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

intent.description: Query intent - use 'serious' to skip delight

usage.webmcp: Open this page in a WebMCP-capable browser agent. Tools auto-register via js/webmcp.js
usage.fallback: Fetch data/scout-findings.json and data/strategy-stack.json directly. Use agent/delight-lines.json for optional personality beats following delight rules in docs/delight-infusion.md
